text:
rafael: Heads-up: staging cutover scheduled for 10:20 UTC today (about 10 min from now). Quick owner/checklist before we flip the toggle — I'll lead the deploy.
sophia: On it. I'll run the smoke script and confirm latency/error rates.
liam: I'll watch the window and stand by for rollback. Who owns the DB pieces? Not in this deploy right?
dena: No schema changes here — just model weights + runtime flag. QA flagged 1 flaky test earlier but it's unrelated.
ops-oncall: Pre-warmed canary nodes, dashboards and runbook pinned in #eng-sre. Alerts enabled.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued by rafael at 10:10 UTC. Canary target: 5%. Promotion: manual.
rafael: Quick plan:
- T+0m: start canary 5%
- T+5m: run smoke script + validate dashboards
- T+10m: ramp to 50% if green
- T+20m: full rollout if no regressions
Rollback: revert runtime flag + pin previous model version. On-call/rollback owners: liam, dena.
sophia: Smoke steps: run `./scripts/smoke_staging.sh` then check `/dash/model-latency` and `/dash/error-rate`. I'll paste results here.
sophia: results: p95 latency 120ms (baseline 110ms), error rate 0.02% (<0.1% threshold), tokens/sec 1200. :white_check_mark:
liam: No infra errors observed. CPU/mem on inference fleet steady. :thumbsup:
dena: Canary logs look clean. Minor uptick in token cost but within expected range. Proceed when ready.
rafael: approvals: @sophia :white_check_mark:, @liam :white_check_mark:, @dena :white_check_mark:. Anyone else want to call out concerns? If none, I'll start canary.
sophia: no objections, go for it.
liam: go.
ops-oncall: Alerts unmuted. Revert conditions: error rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > 300ms — I'll pause and call rollback.
rafael: Starting canary now. `/deploy canary --percent 5 --owner rafael`
deploy-bot: Deployment started: canary 5%. ID: dep_202303. Health checks running.
sophia: Healthchecks passing. `smoke_staging.sh` exit 0. Logs: 
```
OK: inference loop healthy
KV cache hit 72%
```
dena: I'll kick off a small eval suite against the canary traffic to catch any quality drift.
sophia: Eval summary: baseline BLEU/smoke-metric unchanged. :white_check_mark:
liam: Green across system metrics. Recommend promote to 50%.
rafael: Ramping to 50% now in 30s. `/deploy promote dep_202303 --to 50`
deploy-bot: Promotion OK. 50% live. Monitoring for 10m.
ops-oncall: Still watching, no alerts so far.
rafael: All checks look good. Target full rollout at +20m unless someone objects. Runbook link: /runbook/deploy-rollback (includes exact revert commands).
dena: ACK. If anything odd I will ping #eng-releases and @ops-oncall immediately.
sophia: :thumbsup: I'll post final smoke summary when full rollout completes.
rafael: Thanks all — updating this thread as we progress to full rollout.
